description: Return the daily snapshot of crawler activity on Rattlesnakes By Mail for one UTC date: dated facts, a table of crawler requests, context against each crawler's recent history, and links. Pass a six digit label such as 261101 or an ISO date such as 2026-11-01. The numbers come from one website and describe what these crawlers did here, not across the web.

date.description: A snapshot label (YYMMDD) or an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_snapshot
title: Get A Daily Snapshot
